demo.preparation.passport: 1. Decide whether you are asking about a first application or renewal. 2. Check DFA's current instructions for your case and appointment channel. 3. Compare names and personal details across records before submitting anything. 4. Confirm fees, processing expectations, and release instructions directly with DFA.
demo.mistakes.passport: Do not use first-application instructions for a renewal (or the reverse). Do not assume a particular civil-registry document, appointment slot, fee, or processing time applies; confirm it with DFA first.
demo.notes.passport: Passport steps differ by application type and personal circumstances. Confirm the correct route and any identity or civil-registry documents with DFA; this demo does not establish an official document list.
demo.guide.passport: Use the DFA Consular Affairs site to identify your application type and current instructions. Check whether identity or civil-registry records apply to your case, follow the current appointment guidance, and verify payment and release instructions before making plans. Names and personal details should match across documents; ask DFA how to handle a discrepancy.
demo.preparation.nbi: 1. Confirm who is requesting the clearance and its purpose. 2. Check NBI's current identity and application instructions. 3. Use the official portal to review the steps and any appointment details shown for your case. 4. Confirm the amount and payment channel before paying, then follow the issuing office's instructions.
demo.mistakes.nbi: Do not assume every employer requires an NBI Clearance. Do not rely on old ID lists, fees, appointment availability, or validity claims; confirm the current details with NBI.
demo.notes.nbi: NBI Clearance needs depend on the purpose and current NBI process. Confirm the requesting body's purpose, accepted identity evidence, appointment steps, and payment instructions directly with NBI.
demo.guide.nbi: Start at the official NBI Clearance portal. Confirm whether the requesting employer or institution needs a clearance and what purpose to select. Check the current identity instructions and application steps, keep any reference details secure, and confirm the payment and release instructions with NBI.
demo.preparation.driversLicense: 1. Choose the pathway you need to ask LTO about: first application, renewal, or conversion. 2. Confirm eligibility and any route-specific training, medical, or document steps with LTO. 3. Check current testing, appointment, and branch instructions. 4. Verify any fees and transaction steps before paying or travelling.
demo.mistakes.driversLicense: Do not assume one route's requirements apply to another, or that a training, medical, test, fee, or schedule is the same everywhere. Confirm the vehicle class and current pathway with LTO before booking or paying.
demo.notes.driversLicense: LTO pathways have different conditions. Confirm your intended license class and whether first application, renewal, or conversion applies; ask LTO which current prerequisites and documents fit your case.
demo.guide.driversLicense: Use LTO's official website to find the current instructions for your intended license class and transaction. Confirm eligibility, route-specific prerequisites, identity documents, testing or appointment steps, fees, and service availability with LTO before acting. This demo does not determine that you qualify.
demo.preparation.sssPhilhealth: 1. Check whether you already have an SSS number or PhilHealth number before starting another registration. 2. Confirm your member category and current record through each agency's official channels. 3. Ask your employer which reporting or onboarding steps it handles. 4. Check personal details carefully and keep account credentials private.
demo.mistakes.sssPhilhealth: Do not apply for a duplicate number because you cannot find an old record. Do not assume the same steps apply to both agencies or that the employee or employer always files; confirm your specific situation with the agency and employer.
demo.notes.sssPhilhealth: Registration and record updates depend on existing membership and employment circumstances. Check each agency record first, then ask the employer and the relevant agency who handles any next step.
demo.guide.sssPhilhealth: Check your existing SSS and PhilHealth records before considering a new registration. Confirm the current member route and any updates with each agency, and ask your employer which onboarding or reporting actions it handles. Use official agency channels, verify your personal details, and never share passwords or one-time codes with Requisito.

feature.help.description: Choose a goal, answer its situational questions, and review the ordered requirements checklist. Mark a requirement done only after obtaining that document.
feature.help.empty: For current issuing-office instructions, check the source-linked service directory.
help.description: Quick answers about using this independent, source-linked preparation tool.
help.a1: Requisito helps you prepare for predefined goals by organizing document requirements and linking to source information. It is not a government office or approval service.
help.q2: How do I get a checklist?
help.a2: Choose a goal, answer the situational questions, then review the generated requirements in their dependency order.
help.q3: Does marking a requirement done mean the government approved it?
help.a3: No. It records only your preparation progress. A government agency decides whether an application or document is accepted.
help.q4: Why do some records need review?
help.a4: A source link alone does not prove that every detail is current or applies to your situation. Records remain clearly marked until the independent review and approval process is complete.
help.q5: Can Requisito book an appointment for me?
help.a5: No. Requisito does not reserve appointments or promise available slots. Use the linked official agency or service provider to check current instructions and make a booking when offered.
help.q6: Where is my checklist progress saved?
help.a6: Checklist progress is saved in this browser on this device. It is not an account-based cloud sync and may not appear in another browser or device.
help.q7: What should I do if a source or detail looks wrong?
help.a7: Use Report a correction to prepare a source-backed suggestion. The form does not automatically send it; you must review and submit it through the provided destination.
help.a8: The interface offers English, Filipino, and Cebuano. Filipino and Cebuano text is draft translation and may need a native-speaker review.
quiz.title: Requisito readiness quiz
quiz.description: Check your understanding of goals, requirements, source review, and preparation progress. This quiz is about using Requisito, not a government knowledge test.
quiz.goal.prompt: What should you do first to prepare for a goal?
quiz.goal.a: Choose a predefined goal in Requisito.
quiz.goal.c: Assume every document applies to everyone.
quiz.goal.explanation: Start with a predefined goal. Situational answers then help determine which requirements apply.
quiz.questions.prompt: Why does Requisito ask situational questions?
quiz.questions.b: To tailor requirements to relevant circumstances.
quiz.questions.c: To submit personal data to an agency.
quiz.questions.explanation: Answers help select applicable checklist requirements; they do not submit applications or determine government approval.
quiz.completion.prompt: What does marking a checklist requirement done mean?
quiz.completion.b: The issuing agency has confirmed the record.
quiz.completion.c: You are tracking your own preparation progress.
quiz.completion.explanation: Your checklist progress is separate from agency review, document validity, and application approval.
quiz.sources.prompt: What should you do before relying on a requirement or fee?
quiz.sources.a: Treat any linked page as current approval.
quiz.sources.b: Open the source and confirm its current instructions for your situation.
quiz.sources.c: Assume a missing price means the service is free.
quiz.sources.explanation: Check the linked source and responsible office. Missing fee information is not evidence that a service costs nothing.
accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: Requisito includes common accessibility features, but has not been independently certified against WCAG. Please report barriers so they can be reviewed.
accessibility.featureSkip: A skip-to-content link is available at the start of each page.
accessibility.featureKeyboard: Navigation, links, forms, and buttons are designed to work with keyboard input.
accessibility.featureLabels: Forms use visible or programmatic labels, and page changes move focus to the new heading.
accessibility.featureLanguage: The interface can be switched between English, Filipino, and Cebuano; some translations need human review.
accessibility.limitations: Some external sites, documents, and embedded services are outside Requisito's control. Not every route or assistive-technology combination has been audited.
